text:
maria: Heads-up — ap-southeast edge cluster (edge-ams-ap-sg-02) lost 18 H100s overnight. Vendor APEX shipment delayed at origin, RMA flow triggered for 6 DOA units. Need quick decision on partial air uplift vs. consolidated sea + loaners.
vendor_apex: Sorry about the hit, maria. ETA update: manufacturing pushed by 10 days; we can do an air split for 6 units (expedite fee) or ship 12 refurb loaners from EU pool within 3 days. AWB for the air option is available but costs +$3.2k/unit. Do you want us to start DOA paperwork and local customs pre-clear?
chris: Confirming impact — current autoscale bumped to Dedicated fallback earlier, but tail latency spiked for gen-heavy routes. If we only get 6 air units, still short of steady-state by ~12 GPUs for peak.
jordan: Can we pivot some inference load to quantized A800 variants for 2–3 weeks? Perf drop ~8% but cost delta is small. Ops: need decision by EOD to lock expedite.
maria: @chris @jordan yes, can shift non-critical jobs to A800s; but customer-critical realtime features must keep H100. Suggest air 6 + loaner 12 from EU, then staged return when final batch arrives. What's the RMA paperwork needed?
vendor_apex: For the 6-air + 12-loaner plan we need: serials of DOA units, photos of damage, depot claim form (attached link), and a signed AWB consent. Customs HS: 8471.80 (computing machinery) should be fine but please confirm import VAT handle.
lee: I'll pull serials and depot photos this morning. Also confirming whether refurb loaners have matching thermal kits — pinging depot to verify. If loaners require firmware parity, we may need a quick push.
ops-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary shift: route-ml-inferers -> alt-models applied at 2026-03-23T09:12:44Z by chris.
chris: Maria — cost question: air expedite + customs uplift pushes unit econ beyond our burst budget. If we take loaners only, ops risk minor latency for 48–72h while cross-region sync happens. Which risk appetite?
jordan: Customer SLA call: if latency > 120ms for gen-critical we have to open SRE escalation. I'd accept air for the most critical 6, loaners for rest. Can we ask APEX for partial credit on expedite?
vendor_apex: We can offer a 15% expedite rebate if you commit to receiving the final 60-unit batch and sign a short amendment to the PO (covers manufacturing slot). Rebate reduces expedite to ~$2.7k/unit. Also we can pre-pop custom docs to speed clearance.
maria: Sounds reasonable. Action items: 1) lee — photos + serials by 10:30. 2) chris — confirm which routes are critical for H100s (list of 3 endpoints). 3) jordan — draft PO amendment for expedite rebate. 4) vendor_apex — hold air booking pending docs.
lee: On it. Pulling from depot now, will upload photos to the thread (depot name: SGP-DP-07).
vendor_apex: Noted. I put tentative AWB on hold: AWB 775-APX-988 (hold until docs). Docs we need: depot photos, DOA form, copy of Redwood import VAT reg.
chris: Quick orchestration note: if we proceed with air, we should toggle routing policy to prefer dedicated fallback for non-critical 3 routes to protect H100 capacity. I'll schedule a 20-min runbook now.
jordan: Draft PO amendment ready for review in #procurement in 15m. Will include expedite rebate clause and return SLA for loaners.
maria: Also check customs broker: prefer using our broker (Kestrel Customs) for faster clearance. vendor_apex — can you route AWB to Kestrel?
vendor_apex: Yes, we can. Need Kestrel broker contact and Redwood VAT number.
lee: Uploaded photos (SGP-DP-07) and serial list: H100-SN: [H100-8421, H100-8422, H100-8430, H100-8432, H100-8440, H100-8443] — marking 4 as visibly damaged.
maria: Thanks. Jordan/Chris will sync and update procurement/ops. Let's reconvene at 10:45.
ops-bot: [rma-bot] RMA ticket created: RMA-20260323-942. Vendor: APEX. DOA units flagged=6.
vendor_apex: Received serials and photos. Starting depot claim. Holding AWB tentative until Kestrel info. ETA for air uplift (post-clear): 48–72h after AWB confirmation.
chris: If customs clearance looks sticky, fallback plan: spin up a short-term Dedicated burst in us-west for 24h to drain peak queue while loaners rotate in. Cost estimate for 24h burst ~ $9k. Approve?
jordan: Approve from product side — prefer cheaper loaner + air hybrid, but ok to spend $9k for client-critical window if clearance stalls.
maria: Approving $9k burst if needed. Jordan please add contingency clause to PO amendment to cap our exposure.
vendor_apex: Copy. We'll also send serialized manifest and pre-alert to Kestrel once provided.
lee: Kestrel contact: clara@kestrelcustoms.io, VAT: RW-99877211. Sending to vendor_apex now.
vendor_apex: Got it. We'll route AWB to Kestrel and pre-file. Expect pre-clear attempt tonight.
maria: Great. Last note: coordinate depot return labels — prefer consolidated AWB for returns to speed settlement and insurance claim. If APEX needs separate AWBs, note additional brokerage.
vendor_apex: We'll try consolidated return AWB; if not possible we'll flag extra brokerage fees.
chris: Thanks all. Follow-ups: I'll post the small runbook with toggles and SLOs in #eng-oncall. If anything changes before 10:45 ping @maria directly.
maria: Thanks team, appreciate the fast turnaround. :thumbsup:
